title: MSI Vector 16 HX AI A2XWHG-212US: Specs, Price & What You Need to Know
excerpt: A detailed look at the MSI Vector 16 HX AI A2XWHG-212US, including its Core Ultra 7 processor, RTX 5070 Ti graphics, display, memory, storage and current Amazon price.
author: GamersLookingFor

content.heading: What is the MSI Vector 16 HX AI?
paragraphs: The MSI Vector 16 HX AI A2XWHG-212US is a performance-focused gaming laptop built around Intel's Core Ultra 7 255HX processor and NVIDIA's GeForce RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU.
This particular configuration combines the RTX 5070 Ti with 16GB of DDR5 memory, a 512GB NVMe SSD and a 16-inch 1920 x 1200 IPS-Level display running at 144Hz.

content.heading: Performance Hardware
paragraphs: The Core Ultra 7 255HX provides the CPU foundation for demanding games and other processor-heavy workloads.

The RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU is the main gaming component, with 12GB of GDDR7 VRAM in this configuration. The amount of GPU power available in gaming laptops can vary by model, so the exact laptop configuration matters when comparing RTX 5070 Ti machines.

content.heading: Display
paragraphs: The A2XWHG-212US uses a 16-inch IPS-Level panel with a 1920 x 1200 resolution and a 144Hz refresh rate.
A 144Hz panel can provide noticeably smoother motion than a conventional 60Hz display, particularly in fast-paced games.

content.heading: Memory and Storage
paragraphs: This configuration comes with 16GB of DDR5 memory and a 512GB NVMe SSD.

The 16GB memory capacity is a common starting point for modern gaming laptops, while the 512GB SSD provides fast storage but may become limiting for users who keep a large game library installed simultaneously.

content.heading: Current Price
paragraphs: The price displayed on GamersLookingFor is an observed Amazon.com listing price rather than a permanent manufacturer's MSRP.
Laptop prices can change frequently because of retailer promotions, inventory and regional pricing. Always check the retailer listing for the current price before purchasing.

content.heading: Things to Consider
paragraphs: The exact configuration is important when comparing this laptop with another Vector 16 HX AI. MSI sells the Vector 16 HX AI platform in multiple configurations, and specifications such as GPU, memory, storage and display can differ.
For that reason, GamersLookingFor identifies products by their exact SKU whenever possible rather than treating an entire laptop family as one configuration.

content.heading: Final Takeaway
paragraphs: The MSI Vector 16 HX AI A2XWHG-212US is a high-performance gaming laptop configuration centered around the RTX 5070 Ti Laptop GPU and Intel Core Ultra 7 255HX.
Its 16-inch 144Hz display, 16GB memory and 512GB SSD make up the rest of the configuration, while the exact SKU provides the reference point for checking specifications and pricing.
